abstract: Ovarian tumors are one of the major preoccupations in the everyday practice of gynecology. During the period January 1997 through December 2000, 54 cases of ovarian tumors in young females aged 14-20 years were diagnosed and managed laparoscopically in our institution. Twenty-two cases of mature cystic teratoma, 12 cases of endometriosis, eight cases of serous cystadenoma, five cases of mucinous cystadenoma, three cases of fibroma-thecoma, two cases of serous low-malignant tumors and one case of mucinous low-malignant tumor were found. The management of ovarian tumors during this age by laparoscopic techniques represents an efficient and safe procedure.
abstract_ja: 卵巣腫瘍は日常の婦人科診療における主要な関心事の一つである。1997年1月から2000年12月までに、当院で14〜20歳の若年女性54例の卵巣腫瘍を診断し、腹腔鏡下に治療した。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫22例、子宮内膜症12例、漿液性嚢胞腺腫8例、粘液性嚢胞腺腫5例、線維腫-莢膜細胞腫3例、漿液性低悪性度腫瘍2例、粘液性低悪性度腫瘍1例が認められた。若年女性の卵巣腫瘍に対する腹腔鏡手術は、効率的かつ安全な手技である。
